notes.title: "Playable" on Steam Deck and Fixes!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We continue working on fixing and improving the game! This new patch fixes some issues that some of you may have suffered. 

Steam has given the tag "Playable" for the Steam deck! We have to improve a few things (About text being too small and the change of controls) to have the green badge! So, maybe in the future?

We hope you are enjoying Myrmica! You can expect one more update with more sounds and music and maybe some fixes!
